title: Vitals-Lite-Aging
summary: A small fully synthetic vitals dataset (2,500 rows) plus a 10-minute Colab notebook for teaching bio/health ML without PHI. It uses SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer with an Inequality constraint to generate the data and evaluates it with SDMetrics' QualityReport, run directly in the demo notebook.
